from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
import re,hashlib
out=Path.home()/"agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/ui-p1-real-radar-20260912"
root=ET.parse(out/'live.xml').getroot()
static={'Watchlist','Suspicious','Public Safety Signals','Nearby','Unknown / Noise','Paused','Scanning...','No devices match filter'}
flags={s:0 for s in static}
large=[]
for n in root.iter():
    t=n.attrib.get('text','')
    if t in flags: flags[t]+=1
    if n.attrib.get('clickable')!='true': continue
    m=re.fullmatch(r'\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]',n.attrib.get('bounds',''))
    if not m: continue
    x1,y1,x2,y2=map(int,m.groups()); w=x2-x1; h=y2-y1
    if w>=650 and 70<=h<=450 and y1>=150 and y2<=2300:
        large.append((x1,y1,x2,y2,h))
large.sort(key=lambda r:(r[1],r[0]))
print('LIVE_STATIC_FLAGS',','.join(f'{k}={v}' for k,v in sorted(flags.items())))
print('LIVE_LARGE_CLICKABLES',len(large))
print('LIVE_LARGE_HEIGHTS',[r[4] for r in large[:12]])
p=out/'radar-live.png'; print('LIVE_SCREENSHOT_SHA256',hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'BYTES',p.stat().st_size)
PY
